newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Spring and white bids down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Spring and white bids down.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat and soft white wheat bids weakened on Tuesday in sympathy with lower wheat futures on the Chicago Board of Trade, Kansas City Board of Trade and Minneapolis Exchange, dealers said.

Farm sales were scattered with some noted in Minneapolis while none were reported in parts of flood-ravaged North Dakota. "Everybody was fighting the (high) water. Roads are washed out," a Red River Valley grain merchandiser said.
At Fargo, N.D., the Red River was 20 feet above flood stage by mid-afternoon Tuesday. The river was expected to rise by another foot by Thursday before it crests, river officials said.
